detail: Deliberate AC3 revert: compute_session_summary_with_events event-loop (`for event in events { record_event_tool_call(...) }`) commented out, making the computation turn-only. Rerun of `cargo test -p session-api --test copilot_capture_hook_e2e e2e_val_session_api_tool_metrics_gate_asserts_nonempty_tools_map` -> FAILED. Panic: "tool-metrics.json should exist once a tool call was captured from a producer-shaped transcript: Os { code: 2, kind: NotFound, ... }" — with tools empty the hook lazily skips writing tool-metrics.json at all, so the artifact read-back fails outright. This is the proof the gate is real: the turn-only regression is caught by artifact read-back, not by a passing-test count. Implementation reverted back to the real (event-aware) computation immediately after this run; see companion passing execution exec-val-session-api-tool-metrics-e2e-pass-1 (before) and the post-restore rerun.
